subject: english
question:
**Select the word segment that substitutes (replaces) the bracketed word segment correctly and completes the sentence meaningfully:**

Unless you (do will not prepare) well you will not perform well.
solution:
The correct answer is **'prepare'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The correct word segment that substitutes the bracketed word segment and completes the sentence meaningfully is indeed: **prepare**.
 
• In the original sentence, the structure is incorrect. The correct form should be *"Unless you **prepare** well, you will not perform well."*
 
• The word "**prepare**" alone, without any **additional auxiliary verbs, **is grammatically** correct and conveys the intended meaning**. It functions as **the main verb in the sentence**, indicating the action that needs to be taken to achieve the desired outcome.
 
• Therefore, **option 2, "prepare," **is the correct choice.
